registered_before_guard_implementation: 2026-10-17, after accepted-R1 0.8s diagnostic; no acceptance thresholds changed
problem: Accepted R1 startup permits 19.422375ms of angle error above 8deg. Corrected EMF angle error is about +-0.22deg in this interval, while PLL lags about 8deg. Steady precision passes; do not retune SMO to hide a permission defect.

design.rationale: Wrapped-angle triangle inequality: 5deg PLL-to-corrected-EMF budget plus 3deg model budget equals existing 8deg target. The 3deg allowance is an engineering assumption, not a truth bound or hardware guarantee; independently evaluate all required physical cases.
design.packet_valid: existing_quality AND sample_valid AND not_reset AND finite_inputs AND norm(corrected_vector)>=existing_emf_off_threshold AND dot>0 AND abs(cross)<=sin(5deg)*norm(vector)+8*eps*norm(vector)
design.quadrant: positive dot product explicitly excludes the 180deg false-lock ambiguity
design.time: computed with current JEOS theta/vector, captured as packet quality and unavailable to control until the existing JEOS+3us publication. Live ADC/timing veto remains independent.
design.truth_separation: no true theta, speed, motor injection or future samples in guard; existing R1 SMO/PLL/voltage/current states remain unchanged
design.scope: normal packet quality only; this alone does not satisfy pending reset/missing/schedule injection requirements

component_tests: both directions and wrap, exactly 5deg and 5deg+1e-6deg, 90/180deg aliases, scale changes, zero/nonfinite vector, old-quality/sample/reset veto; verify observed pre-fix trace as diagnostic only
physical_tests: new-version 20ms original52/common81 exact precheck, then unchanged 3000rpm 0.8s test including full-run native false-valid <=2ms; retain the failed R1 numerical diagnostic; subsequent full 14-case matrix remains mandatory
failure_policy: max one explicit native retry per case/version across labels; no numerical failure rerun or third same-version retry
measurement: native evaluator unchanged; cumulative logging every50us, all state transitions/publications logged at native62.5ns; old52 configured retention remains unchanged, bounded logs are disclosed
